newsitem.title: GERMANY: Italy's Scalfaro to visit Germany in April. [CORRECTED 13:28 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Italy's Scalfaro to visit Germany in April. [CORRECTED 13:28 GMT]

text.p: Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro will visit Germany from April 21 to April 23, the office of German President Roman Herzog said on Friday.

Scalfaro will be greeted with full military honours at the Bellevue castle in Berlin (corrects from Bonn) on April 21, followed by lunch and talks with Herzog. The German President will host a dinner for Scalfaro the following day.
